svg.title: The rotate, slice, clip, zigzag algorithm for turning a polygon into flight lines
svg.desc: Four panels. One: the area-of-interest polygon is rotated so the flight azimuth aligns with an axis. Two: horizontal lines spaced S apart are laid across the bounding box. Three: the lines are clipped to the polygon. Four: the clipped segments are joined in a back-and-forth boustrophedon path of waypoints.
